# Dragon Refunds

> Dragon Refunds finds the FBA reimbursements Amazon owes an Amazon seller — lost and damaged
> inventory, short-received shipments, fee and dimension overcharges, refunds where the item was
> never returned, and sourcing-cost errors — and shows the exact action to recover each one. Finding
> them is free forever. File the claims yourself and keep 100%, or hand a claim off for 15% of what
> is actually recovered.

## Core facts
- Product: Amazon FBA reimbursement recovery for Amazon sellers.
- DIY: free forever. The full audit of your reimbursement history, itemized by cause, plus the steps
  to file each claim yourself through Seller Central. You keep 100%. No credit card required.
- Hands-free: 15% of what is actually recovered on a claim, charged only if the claim is won. No
  monthly fee and nothing up front. Managed reimbursement services typically take around 25%.
- DIY and hands-free are decided claim by claim; you are never locked into one.
- No subscription. Finding what Amazon owes you is always free.
- Claim types: lost, damaged, short-received, fee overcharges and customer returns — across FBA,
  AWD, and every region you sell in.
- Claims are ranked by filing deadline rather than dollar value, because Amazon's windows are short:
  lost-in-transit removal claims expire 75 days after the ship date.
- Amazon connection: the official Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API). Dragon Refunds is an
  authorized Amazon SP-API application.
- Company: Chacha Advisory LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.
- Website: https://dragonrefunds.com — sign-up: https://app.dragonrefunds.com/sign-up

## Core pages

- Sibling products from the same company: [DragonBot](https://getdragonbot.com) (Amazon MCP server
  and AI operator) and [Dragon Reply](https://dragonreply.ai) (Buyer-Seller Messaging inbox)

## What it is not
- Not an Amazon product; not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
- Not a monthly subscription — the only charge is 15% on claims you choose to hand off.
- Not a 25%-of-everything managed service: every claim is visible and yours to file for $0.
- Not a general Amazon analytics, PPC, or listing tool.
